### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. People will set its goals, define its limits, and retain the power to shut it down.

2. Superintelligent AI will not take control away from humanity. We will govern how it is built, where it is deployed, and what it is allowed to do. Humans will remain firmly in charge.

3. We will build safeguards, enforce clear rules, and maintain human authority over every advanced AI system. If superintelligent AI arrives within 20 years, it will remain a tool under our control.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. That conviction rests on a simple truth: AI is created, deployed, and governed by people. We will set its objectives, define its permissions, limit its access, and retain the authority to shut it down. Strong technical safeguards, rigorous testing, clear laws, and accountable institutions will keep human judgment in command. Superintelligence will not erase human agency; it will amplify the capabilities we choose to give it. As development advances, we will insist on control at every stage. The future of AI will be shaped by human decisions, and humans will remain firmly in charge.
